summary: Recent updates to Firefox's video colour conversion processes have refined how the browser handles YCbCr (a color space used in video) to RGB (the standard color format for displays). These changes aim to optimize performance by ensuring that the browser only uses older, less efficient methods for conversion if they can be accelerated by assembly code, which makes them faster. This is significant because **improved video color handling leads to better visual quality during playback**, enhancing the overall viewing experience.
